eventChain: Main character realizes that tonight's choice will alter everyone's fate.
Choice presented: investigate anomaly source or protect companions.
If investigating, main character follows clues to discover a repeatable pattern.
If protecting, main character misses first clue but gains deeper trust.
In ending 1, main character breaks the cycle and walks toward a new dawn.
In ending 2, main character keeps the secret, maintaining the status quo, yet knows how to choose next time.
